approval_scope: Planning only. A separate owner decision plus exact committed prelaunch gates is required to execute this proposal.
question: Does the existing 601-byte let mismatch/control regression distinguish the exact 9face guard-negation mutant from its pinned Nanoda baseline?
limit_rationale: Four primary cells plus at most four counted same-input repair replays. One isolated mutant build expected; one additional counted tooling/build repair reservation. These proposed caps are independent of closed historical allocations and are not authorized by this planning record.

allowed_adapter_changes.export_file_path: Exact committed absolute path to the selected control or candidate

configuration.delivery: One immutable per-input configuration; both observers use identical input-specific settings. lib/cvc_process.py uses DEVNULL for stdin.

build_plan.source: Exact pinned-nanoda source snapshot; apply only the bound existing mutation spec after future authorization. Preserve all other source bytes.
build_plan.toolchain_prerequisite: Bind exact installed rustc/cargo executable identities, dependency cache/lock and build environment before counted build. No install or dependency fetch. Missing payload stops the dependent launch.
build_plan.derivation_receipt: Bind source snapshot, exact patch and all resulting source bytes, Cargo files, toolchain/environment, reserved build number, command, raw logs and resulting mutant binary hash before observer cells.
build_plan.baseline_source_prerequisite: Verify source tree/revision and recorded baseline binary association; pin current baseline bytes to the existing historical receipt.
build_plan.mutant_binary_prerequisite: Must derive a fresh 9face product; do not use historical 21ef or any shared overwritten executable.

tooling_reuse.required_successor: Minimal dedicated runner with current queue gate, prelaunch validation, raw logs and append-only reservations; no general scheduler and no edits to frozen historical tooling. This runner is not implemented by ALT-SURVIVORS.

prelaunch_gates.condition: Explicit owner authorization of SURVIVOR-LET-REUSE-1 and this fixed proposal reflected in authoritative status/queue; selected ACTIVE with live work interval.
All science inputs and exact new per-input configs committed and hashed; candidate/control match the bound historical bytes and matrix has exactly four primary cells.
Exact source and baseline association, installed toolchain and offline dependencies validated; isolated source copy and single-spec patch validated; no historical checkout mutation.

Dedicated tooling revision and negative tests bind authorization refusal, input drift, same-item accounting/repair, failed reservation retention, process supervision, controls-before-candidates and outcome attribution; passing focused tests and committed tooling before research launch.
Before observer launch, counted offline build receipt binds exact selected mutation source to the immutable resulting binary and both executable hashes are checked.
Single launch owner and append-only intact ledger; sufficient remaining cumulative time/build/checker budgets; no unknown active child or unreconciled timeout, cancellation, accounting or cleanup.
Both fresh controls accepted with exact success output and clean process receipts before either candidate; parser/fatal/timeout results cannot count as expected typecheck refusal.

attribution: Require baseline candidate refusal to match the precise infer_let/assert_def_eq path with both controls accepted and verified binary derivation; an exit code alone is insufficient. Preserve each other outcome separately. No majority vote or model output establishes semantic authority.
stopping_rules: Stop after the fixed matrix yields attributable comparison and a concrete local recommendation; no additional candidate or corpus campaign.

Ordinary tooling/build/audit faults pause dependent launches for smallest feasible same-item repair; retain original logs, reservations and scientific inputs, bind new tooling revisions and rerun affected checks within remaining caps.

Stop at actual cap, absent required local payload, changed scientific inputs, authority blocker, or diagnosed gap with no feasible authorized repair; retain BOUNDED_UNRESOLVED without inferring equivalence.
No fresh successful comparison: preserve selected SURVIVED_WITHOUT_WITNESS classification. An unexpected comparison is evidence to report, not permission to alter the pair or expectations.

A successful comparison supports associating the already admitted regression with this distinct mutation identity via the canonical append-only classification/admission route after its required evidence checks; no second corpus artifact or new upstream report.
closure_requirements: Exact raw and normalized results and cost receipts
Local regression-association recommendation or bounded unresolved result
Required current/historical full-payload suite and historical transition checks
Main-only commit and scripts/push-main; select next item without executing it

scientific_variant_scope.max_scientific_byte_variants_means: Zero new candidate/control export-stream variants; reuse both exact historical NDJSON files.
scientific_variant_scope.source_materialization: After future authorization only, derive exactly the bound 9face source patch from the pinned baseline. A repair rebuild uses the same resulting source bytes; no additional mutation identity or source variant.
